prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” branding agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on what you need (brand strategy vs. visual identity vs. naming vs. packaging vs. digital), your industry, budget, timeline, and whether you want a local partner or are open to remote firms.

To help you find the best fit I can do a tailored shortlist, but first tell me:
- What’s the project? (rebrand, new brand, naming, packaging, website, etc.)
- Company size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B or B2C)
- Budget range (ballpark)
- Timeline
- Do you require the agency to be local in St. Louis, or is remote OK?

If you want to decide on your own, here are quick, practical next steps and evaluation criteria:

How to evaluate agencies
- Relevant portfolio: look for case studies that match your industry or project type.
- Strategy-first approach: does the work show clear strategy and measurable results, not just pretty design?
- Team and expertise: who will do the work — senior strategists or juniors?
- Process and deliverables: clear phases, timelines, milestones, and tangible deliverables (brand book, assets, templates).
- Results & metrics: evidence of improved KPIs (awareness, sales, web traffic, conversions).
- Client references & longevity: recent references you can contact.
- Ongoing support: governance, training, or agency support post-launch.
- Culture/chemistry: you’ll work closely with them — fit matters.

Useful questions to ask agencies
- Can you show case studies similar to our project?
- What’s your process for research, positioning, and naming (if applicable)?
- Who will be on the team and how many hours will they commit?
- What are deliverables and milestones? What’s the timeline?
- What is the total cost and payment schedule? Any additional fees?
- How do you measure success and report results?
- Who owns final assets?
- Can you provide client references?

Typical pricing ranges (very approximate)
- Small identity or logo work: $5k–$20k
- Full brand strategy + identity + guidelines: $25k–$100k
- Large-scale rebrands (research, naming, rollout, digital, packaging): $100k+

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll research and recommend a short list (3–6) of St. Louis branding agencies matched to your needs — with a summary of strengths, relevant case studies, estimated budgets, and next-step contact suggestions. Which would you prefer?
